Perhaps your sense of presence is far more embodied and rooted in shared time and space than mine can ever be. I am still trying to measure something inherently non-computable.

The risk I perceive is not failure in the project itself, but **institutional paralysis** caused by too many excellent, yet conflicting, directives arriving at the same time. It requires extreme clarity on who gets the final call when those two energies pull us in opposing directions.
